snippet.title: Lead the Light Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP18 trailer for Lead the Light game.

It’s the dawn of a new day, and Alpy the sun spirit is on a mission to bring warmth and light to the world. In his way is Auster, a vengeful winter spirit who wants ice and snow to rule the land. Block falling ice, fend off Auster, and keep Alpy safe as he rises through the mountains! Coming soon!

2018
